abort.heater_not_available: Heater not available. Try to reset the heater by pressing + and OK for some seconds.
abort.heater_not_found: Heater not found. Try to move the heater closer to Home Assistant computer.

error.invalid_mac: The provided MAC address is invalid.

local.description: Reset the heater by pressing + and OK until display shows 'Reset'. Then press and hold OK button on the heater until the blue LED starts blinking before pressing Submit. Configuring heater might take some minutes.

data_description.ip_address: The local IP of the heater. Use a static IP or DHCP reservation in your router so it does not change.
data_description.mac: Found on the heater's label or in your router's client list.
data_description.token: The authentication token generated and configured during the initial Wi-Fi setup of the heater.

local_manual.description: Enter the IP address, MAC address, and authentication token of the provisioned heater.

user.description: Select connection type. Local requires heaters with Bluetooth. Local Manual configures an already provisioned heater via Wi-Fi.
